stem: An EC2 ETL job hard-codes an RDS password. Security requires removing the hard-coded secret and rotating credentials without redeploying the app each rotation. Which two actions help?

options.label: A
options.body: Store credentials in AWS Secrets Manager

options.label: B
options.body: Enable rotation and have the application retrieve the secret at runtime

options.label: C
options.body: Commit the password to a public GitHub gist for centralized access

options.label: D
options.body: Disable SSL on RDS to simplify clients

options.label: E
options.body: Share one IAM access key in Slack

explanation: Secrets Manager plus runtime retrieval enables rotation without baking passwords into builds.
